purpose: Define stable, minimal Island exports for downstream generators and editors without granting every consumer unrestricted access to the full Island profile.

commonEnvelope.identityRule: When produced from a canonical editor envelope, profileId and revision must be copied and consumed as a pinned-revision source reference.
commonEnvelope.stableIdRule: All nested IDs remain the source Island IDs. Consumers may reference them but must not silently rename them.
commonEnvelope.visibilityRule: Player-safe consumers receive only public or player-known sites and hazards. GM-only IDs and gmSecrets are excluded unless the consumer explicitly declares gmScope true.
commonEnvelope.copyRule: Consumer payloads are detached copies. A downstream editor cannot mutate the parent Island by editing its imported payload.
commonEnvelope.freshnessRule: A consumer must display the source revision and warn when a newer parent revision exists; it must not silently replace a pinned parent snapshot.

reconciliationRules: Every exported cell ID must exist in source map.cells.
Every exported settlement slot ID must exist in source settlementCapacity.settlementSlots.
Every water source and landing zone included for a settlement slot must be referenced by that slot.
Every exported habitat cell must be referenced by the exported habitat.
Every route node landingZoneId must resolve to an exported landing zone.
Every approach corridor landingZoneId must resolve to an exported landing zone.
Every exported approach hazard must be referenced by an exported corridor or node context.
Population sustainable capacity must equal the binding minimum represented by the source settlementCapacity contract.
No downstream fixture may contain the literal source gmSecrets text.
activationRule: After P1 activation, downstreamExports in the Island profile must be produced from these boundaries and validated before a consumer editor accepts them.
